value.rationale: The result provides a closed bivariate product-rank enumerator and all rank layers for the canonical idempotent-generated partial regressive order-preserving semigroup PC_n. Such ranks naturally measure semilattice products of idempotents and are not determined by earlier idempotent ranks, total transformations, or partial-involution counts. The renewal description is a uniform structural classification of the enumeration, not an arbitrary small-n census.
